rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - Restrictions on Criminal Record Inquiries
rules.requirement: A housing provider shall not require an applicant to complete any housing application that includes inquiries regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to a conditional offer, except for specific drug-related and sex offender registration criteria. A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords in New Jersey cannot ask about your criminal record before making a conditional offer to rent, except for certain drug and sex offender cases.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios en Nueva Jersey no pueden preguntar sobre su historial criminal antes de hacer una oferta condicional para alquilar, excepto en ciertos casos relacionados con drogas y registro de delincuentes sexuales.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are exempt.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not require an applicant to complete any housing application that includes any inquiries regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to the provision of a conditional offer... A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - Limitations on Consideration of Criminal Records
rules.requirement: A housing provider shall not evaluate an applicant based on arrests not resulting in conviction, expunged convictions, pardoned convictions, vacated convictions, juvenile adjudications, or sealed records. After a conditional offer, only certain recent or serious convictions may be considered.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords cannot consider arrests without convictions or old/expunged records when screening tenants. Only certain recent or serious convictions can be considered after a conditional offer.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios no pueden considerar arrestos sin condenas o antecedentes antiguos/borrados al evaluar a los inquilinos. Solo se pueden considerar ciertas condenas recientes o graves después de una oferta condicional.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are exempt.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not, either before or after the issuance of a conditional offer, evaluate an applicant based on any of the following types of criminal records: (1) arrests or charges that have not resulted in a criminal conviction; (2) expunged convictions; (3) convictions erased through executive pardon; (4) vacated and otherwise legally nullified convictions; (5) juvenile adjudications of delinquency; and (6) records that have been sealed.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - Conditional Offer Withdrawal and Individualized Assessment
rules.requirement: A housing provider may withdraw a conditional offer based on criminal record only if necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate, and nondiscriminatory interest, providing written reasons and opportunity to appeal with evidence of inaccuracies or rehabilitation. An individualized assessment considering factors such as nature of offense, age, time elapsed, rehabilitation, safety impact, and connection to property is required.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords can only reject you after a conditional offer if they have a good, fair reason related to your criminal record, and they must explain why and let you appeal with evidence.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios solo pueden rechazarlo después de una oferta condicional si tienen una razón justa relacionada con su historial criminal, y deben explicar por qué y permitirle apelar con evidencia.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are exempt.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider may withdraw a conditional offer based on an applicant's criminal record only if the housing provider determines, by preponderance of the evidence, that the withdrawal is necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate, and nondiscriminatory interest... The housing provider shall perform an individualized assessment of the application in light of the following factors: (a) the nature and severity of the criminal offense; (b) the age of the applicant at the time of the occurrence of the criminal offense; (c) the time which has elapsed since the occurrence of the criminal offense; (d) any information produced by the applicant...

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - Disclosure Requirements Before Application Fee
rules.requirement: Before accepting any application fee, a housing provider must disclose in writing whether criminal history is considered in eligibility and inform applicants of their right to provide evidence of inaccuracies or rehabilitation.
rules.summary_plain: Before charging an application fee, landlords must tell you if they check criminal history and that you can provide evidence to correct or explain your record.
rules.summary_plain_es: Antes de cobrar una tarifa de solicitud, los propietarios deben informarle si revisan el historial criminal y que puede proporcionar evidencia para corregir o explicar su historial.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are exempt.
rules.quoted_span: Prior to accepting any application fee, a housing provider shall disclose in writing to the applicant: (1) Whether the eligibility criteria of the housing provider include the review and consideration of criminal history; and (2) A statement that the applicant... may provide evidence demonstrating inaccuracies within the applicant's criminal record or evidence of rehabilitation or other mitigating factors.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - Prohibition on Discriminatory Advertising
rules.requirement: A housing provider shall not knowingly publish any advertisement that excludes applicants based on criminal records except for specific drug-related and sex offender registration cases. They also shall not use or distribute criminal records inconsistently with the Act.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords cannot advertise that they won’t rent to people with criminal records except in certain drug and sex offender cases, and they must handle criminal records properly.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios no pueden anunciar que no alquilarán a personas con antecedentes penales excepto en ciertos casos de drogas y delincuentes sexuales, y deben manejar los antecedentes penales adecuadamente.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are exempt.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not knowingly or purposefully publish, or cause to be published, any housing advertisement that explicitly provides that the housing provider will not consider any applicant who has been arrested or convicted of one or more crimes or offenses, except for drug-related criminal activity for the manufacture or production of methamphetamine on the premises of federally assisted housing, and whether the applicant is subject to a lifetime registration requirement under a State sex offender registration program.
